context_requirements: Mitochondrial activity and intact electron transport chain for ROS/RNS generation
Sodium channel expression is not required; effects occur independent of Na+ channel blockade
Concentrations at or above ~0.1-1 mM for growth/survival effects; 10 uM may be sub-threshold in some lines
Proliferating cells with active cell cycle for antiproliferative readouts
falsifiers: No change in FOS/JUN/EGR1 or HSPA1A/DNAJB1 at 6 h in any line
No decrease in proliferation/cell-cycle genes at 24 h
No evidence of apoptosis or oxidative stress response at 24 h
Responses equal in all nine lines regardless of lineage or metabolic capacity

evidence.supports: Lidocaine causes mitochondrial membrane potential loss, cytochrome c release, caspase activation and apoptosis in neuronal cells
Local anesthetics induce apoptosis in human chondrocytes
Bupivacaine inhibits growth/survival via mitochondrial complex I/II inhibition and affects Rho family activity
Lidocaine inhibits proliferation and induces apoptosis via PI3K/AKT/mTOR and Bax/Bcl2 pathways
Lidocaine increases mitochondrial depolarization, ROS/RNS and alters ATP:ADP ratio

changes: Removed generic proliferation genes (MYC, CCND1, PCNA, MCM3, TOP2A, AURKA, AURKB, PLK1, BIRC5, CDK1, CCNB1, CCNA2, UBE2C, NUSAP1, KIF20A) from proximal_down; these are not immediate transcriptional targets of sodium channel blockade and belong to generic proliferation_down.
Removed SQSTM1 from late_up because it already appears in proximal_up; a gene must not appear in both an up and a down list of the same time.
Removed HSPA1A, DNAJB1, HSPB1, BAG3 from proximal_up; heat-shock/proteostasis genes are generic stress responses, not proximal to local anesthetic sodium channel blockade.

Removed DDIT4, TRIB3, CHAC1, GADD45A, BNIP3, BNIP3L, PMAIP1, BAX, HMOX1, TXNRD1, HERPUD1, XBP1, ATF5 from late_up; these are generic apoptosis, oxidative stress, or unfolded protein response genes rather than specific late transcriptional consequences of local anesthetic action.
Removed CCNE2, CDK2, CDK4, CDK6, E2F2 from late_down; these are generic proliferation genes and not specific late targets of local anesthetics.
Kept primary_targets as SCN5A, SCN10A, SCN1A because local anesthetics block voltage-gated sodium channels, but noted that the cited evidence does not support transcriptional profiling at 10 uM.
Kept kinetics as fast because immediate early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1) and stress responses can occur within 6 h, but the 10 uM concentration may be sub-threshold for many effects.
Kept magnitude as moderate at 6 h and strong at 24 h, consistent with time-dependent apoptosis and stress responses, but the evidence is from high concentrations (0.1-5 mM) and not 10 uM.
Kept line_response as moderate/weak/strong based on general metabolic and proliferative differences, but no direct evidence supports these specific levels at 10 uM.
Kept context_requirements and falsifiers as they are consistent with the mechanism and evidence.
Kept all evidence citations because their abstracts support the stated claims about local anesthetic effects on mitochondria, apoptosis, and proliferation.
